objective: Implement durable approval interrupts and deterministic resume behavior with assignment-scoped authority, isolated checkpoints, and recovery tests for stale approval, callback replay, restart, and idempotency.
non_goals: Perform external writes from the graph
Deploy or enable the graph in any environment
Cut over writer authority from the legacy engine
Change deterministic policy or assignment-scoped approval authority
constraints: Start from the exact bound main SHA and preserve the accepted Gate 0 evidence from PR #18
Keep the legacy engine the sole writer and rollback authority
Keep every LangGraph feature flag default-off in every configuration profile
Use a separate SQLite checkpoint namespace and do not write legacy tables
Fail closed on unknown packet fields, stale approvals, ambiguous authority, or schema mismatch
Do not modify provider-neutral v1 schemas in this assignment
Do not merge; request an independent exact-head review after implementation
Part 2 may be independently authored from main but cannot enter the integration chain until Part 1 has an accepted outcome digest
acceptance_checks: All assignment-specific transition, recovery, and shadow-comparison tests pass
Docker Compose validation passes for every supported profile
Dependency and lock integrity checks pass
Independent reviewer accepts the exact implementation head
evidence_requirements: Exact starting SHA, implementation head SHA, and complete changed-file list
Commands and unabridged pass/fail summaries for every required check
Proof that all graph flags default to false
Proof that the legacy engine remains the sole writer
Proof that the LangGraph checkpoint namespace is isolated
Independent review verdict bound to the exact implementation head
approval_requirements: Independent exact-head ACCEPT from OpenAI Codex
Owner approval before merge, deployment, enablement, migration, or writer cutover
Fresh authority binding if any authority snapshot blob changes
